verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm offering legal services. Event-subscription webhooks are an API-platform capability outside that product category, so this is a wrong-axis question rather than a missing feature. The evidence mentions client tech such as trademark extranets, 'intelligent alerts' and 'web services', but none of it documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
